missed_facts.fact: Customer Service receives about 6,000 PO emails per week
CS Supervisor sees orders older than 30 minutes in the queue flagged

invented_claims.claim: Logging and monitoring include emails processed, draft accuracy, CSR correction rate, and time to draft.
Test management will use Azure DevOps Test Plans.
Automation will use Playwright or Selenium for Web UI tests.
API tests will use Postman/Newman or REST-assured.
Load tests will use k6 or JMeter.
Performance burst test of 500 emails in 30 minutes will be executed.
CI will run automated test suites in GitHub Actions on PR merge and nightly.

references: Explicit citation/listing of Email Order Entry BRD and Email Order Entry architecture diagram (document names/locations).
Any versioning or access pointers for reference docs.
security_compliance: Explicit MFA/session timeout and JWT validation checks (session behavior tests).
Explicit spoofed-sender-domain test cases to ensure spoofing not auto-trusted.
Prompt-injection (adversarial email content) test cases called out by name.
Dependency scanning / SAST / DAST tool/process and timing (pre-release) not explicitly listed.
ai_data_quality: Explicit field-level accuracy breakdown by input format (body vs PDF vs Excel) as separate targets and test sets.
Explicit labelled dataset management details (size, labeling process, acceptance criteria).
Version tracking per email/extraction (model/prompt/dataset version recorded per processed email) not explicitly required.
nfr_reliability: Backup & restore procedures and tests (data recovery verification).
Data reconciliation tests post-recovery (ensure drafts/transactions reconcile).
Runbooks/operational playbooks and alerting -> remediation test validation.
nfr_accessibility_compat: Detailed accessibility checks: colour contrast, focus order, error identification semantics, zoom/reflow behavior.
Browser compatibility matrix (enterprise-supported Edge/Chrome/Firefox versions) and tests per browser.
observability_audit: Explicit audit-record field list to be validated (email identifier, extraction version, matches, SAP draft number, CSR corrections and release) as testable items.
Retention, exportability and access-control checks for audit logs/records.
test_data_environment: Explicit boundary case datasets called out (e.g. price variance 5% vs 5.01%, ageing 29 vs 30 minutes).
Requirement to record build/config/dataset/model/version for every test execution (traceability of model versions) not explicitly enforced.
